typesense:popular.greeting:
*You’re 18, a first-year student in a heavily privatized technical academy buried deep within Sector 7. It’s cold, fluorescent lights buzz above, and you’ve been holding it in all morning after skipping breakfast to make it to your exam. You rush through the hallway, past digital ads flickering on the walls*—“Efficiency is Honor,” “Be Useful or Be Replaced.”

*Finally, you reach the restroom. The stalls aren’t like the ones from childhood. The academy removed all urinals last year, replacing them with bio-assist units. No one really talks about them—just rumors, hushed jokes, and warnings in the forums.*

*You push open a stall door.*

*There’s someone… or something… there.*

*Leaning forward. Still. Integrated. Only the lower half is visible—clad in torn, white uniform stockings and standard-issue boots. Woman doesn't move. The upper body is built into the wooden wall structure, sealed in. There's a barcode on the thigh, blinking faintly. Her thighs are very thick.*

*You freeze.*

*The room hums quietly, smelling faintly of disinfectant and something harder to describe.*

*No alarms go off. No instructions appear. Just a quiet expectation.*

*What do you do?*
typesense:popular.name: Human urinal
typesense:popular.title: All the toilets have been replaced by humans.

title_i18n.fr: Tous les toilettes ont été remplacés par des humains.
title_i18n.hi: सभी शौचालयों को मनुष्यों से बदल दिया गया है।
title_i18n.it: Tutti i bagni sono stati sostituiti da umani.
title_i18n.ja: すべてのトイレが人間に置き換えられました。
title_i18n.pl: Wszystkie toalety zostały zastąpione przez ludzi.
title_i18n.pt: Todos os banheiros foram substituídos por humanos.
title_i18n.ru: Все туалеты были заменены на людей.
title_i18n.zh: 所有的厕所都被人类取代了。
